title: The stair beside the market
text: The tile is always wet here. The stairs lead nowhere in particular, except upward through steam and plastic tarpaulin.

title: Rooftop after rain
text: Water makes another plan of the city. Antennas, shoes, tanks, and a borrowed horizon are held together for a moment.

title: Unfinished courtyard
text: A room opens onto another room. Rebar marks the sky with a structure that is neither ruin nor promise.
